confusion_matrix_analysis.ultralytics_P_R_operating_point: P and R in the metrics table are read at the confidence that maximises the mean F1 over the validation run (validator conf=0.001, NMS IoU=0.7).
confusion_matrix_analysis.finding_1: The matrix (conf 0.25) and the table (max-F1 confidence) use different operating points, so their P/R legitimately differ.
confusion_matrix_analysis.finding_2: More important: the Fig. 5(a) counts are IDENTICAL to the confusion_matrix.png of the 2023 plain YOLOv8x run (no CBAM), and Fig. 5(b)'s legend reads 'all classes 0.892 mAP@0.5' = the baseline's 89.2 %, not CBAM's claimed 92.93 %. Fig. 5 therefore shows the BASELINE model.
